title: Effect of a Wanderlane Traveller Club Tier on Prices across the Wanderlane Portfolio
content:
**Interaction note issued with the product desks of the Wanderlane Travel Group.**

Holding a Wanderlane Traveller Club tier changes what the member pays elsewhere in the portfolio: the tier's hotel, car rental, package and insurance discounts apply to the rates of those products, and the product's own rules decide everything else.

## Where the discount attaches

A club discount is applied to the room, vehicle, package or premium price before taxes and third-party fees, never after. The price before taxes and third-party fees is accordingly the basis on which the discount is worked out.

Points accrue on the discounted price actually paid and not on the price before the discount.

## Where the discount does not attach

A club discount and a corporate programme rate are mutually exclusive: where a booking carries a corporate programme reference the corporate rate stands alone and the club discount is not applied on top.

No club discount is applied to a booking paid for entirely with points, because the price paid in money is nothing.

## A tier that changes between booking and travel

Where the member's tier changes between booking and travel, the discount that was applied at booking stands and is neither topped up nor clawed back. This holds in both directions: a tier that has risen since booking does not earn a further reduction on that booking, and a tier that has fallen since booking does not have the reduction taken back.

## The same note as circumstance and treatment

| The booking before the desk | The club discount |
|---|---|
| An ordinary consumer booking on a qualifying rate, made while holding a tier | Applied to the price before taxes and third-party fees |
| A booking carrying a corporate programme reference | Not applied; the corporate rate stands alone |
| A booking paid for entirely with points | Not applied; the price paid in money is nothing |
| A booking made at one tier and travelled at another | The discount applied at booking stands, neither topped up nor clawed back |

## Points of judgement

The discount and the accrual are read off the same figure in sequence: the discount comes off the price before taxes and third-party fees, and the points are then measured against the discounted price the member actually paid.

What the discount does not settle is settled by the product itself. This note governs the reduction a club tier carries into a hotel, car rental, package or travel protection booking; everything else about that booking is decided by the rules of that product.
